name: impeccable
description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
one_liner: Teaches an AI coding assistant good visual taste, so the apps and sites it builds stop looking like generic 'AI slop' and start looking designed.
buyer: A non-designer founder or solo developer shipping their own product who can't afford a designer but is embarrassed by how their AI-generated UI looks.
business_use_cases: A bootstrapped SaaS founder installs it so their coding agent stops generating the same cookie-cutter rounded-card dashboard every project ships with.
A small agency building client sites with AI tools uses it to raise the visual bar across every deliverable without hiring a designer.
A hackathon team runs it right before demo day so their AI-built prototype looks polished in front of judges.

money_ideas.idea: Paid curated style packs beyond the free defaults, aimed at specific industries (real estate, restaurants, fitness).
Agency/team license bundling it with templates and a Slack-based design review bot.

steal_this: Build a small before/after gallery of real AI-generated pages styled with it vs. without, then sell the install-and-setup as a flat $49 service to indie hackers.
